description.describe_ch: 卡爾‧雅斯培（Karl Theodor Jaspers，1883-1969）在《論歷史的起源與目標》中提出於800-200B.C.間，世界上幾個主要的宗教、文化出現重大的哲學突破，而稱此時期為「軸心時代」（Axial Age）。托卡‧帕森斯（Talcott Parsons，1902-1979）進一步界定西元前第一個千紀時，希臘、以色列、印度和中國等地均發生了「軸心突破」。而此時正是中國先秦百家爭鳴的時代。余英時（1930-2021）認為中國先秦諸子的思想，只有在其他古文化──特別是西方──的對照之下，中國軸心突破的文化特色才能充分地顯現出來。本課程一方面以世界文明史的「軸心時代」為宏觀背景；二方面將先秦諸子置於該背景中，探討其思想；三方面期能藉古鑑今，使第一「軸心時代」和今日的第二「軸心時代」產生思想碰撞、對話。透過上述設計，盼能讓學生對於古今交會有更深刻的瞭解與思索。
description.describe_eh:
"Karl Jaspers (1883–1969), in The Origin and Goal of History, proposed that between 800–200 B.C., major civilizations experienced profound philosophical breakthroughs, a period he called the “Axial Age.” Talcott Parsons (1902–1979) further defined this as the first millennium B.C., when Greece, Israel, India, and China each underwent such an “axial breakthrough.” In China, this coincided with the vibrant intellectual ferment of the pre-Qin thinkers. According to Yu Ying-shih (1930-2021), the distinct cultural features of China’s axial breakthrough become fully visible only in comparison with other ancient civilizations, especially the West.
This course takes the Axial Age in world history as a broad framework, situates the pre-Qin masters within it, and explores their thought in this comparative light. Finally, it seeks to foster dialogue between the “first Axial Age” and today’s emerging “second Axial Age,” encouraging students to reflect on the encounter between ancient and modern, East and West, with deeper insight."
